title: LoomTypedSurrealSchemaAndRepositoryBoundary
clause: Define and implement the typed SurrealDB schema, rollout and repository boundary for the complete Loom semantic contract.

current_source_discovery: Inspect MT-381's accepted matrix and rediscover stable-main Loom schema, rollout, repository, API and EventLedger seams.
Record exact table/relation names and repository traits before editing; candidate paths are not authority.
stop_conditions: MT-381 lacks an accepted validator verdict.
A required behavior has no typed Surreal representation or privacy rule.

scope.summary: Replace Loom's residual relational assumptions with SCHEMAFULL Surreal records and relation tables behind typed repositories. Preserve EventLedger atomicity and make every record project-qualified.
forbidden_paths: Direct Surreal SDK calls outside the owning repository boundary
Product behavior outside the MT-381 parity matrix
acceptance_criteria: SCHEMAFULL records and typed relation tables represent every core Loom entity and required edge with project_id, ownership, AccessSpace and lifecycle fields.
All mutations use typed repositories and commit canonical state, EventLedger receipt and projection outbox atomically in SurrealDB.
Schema rollout is ordered, restart-safe and idempotent against a fresh embedded SurrealDB and an already-upgraded database.
Repository APIs preserve ordering, pagination, uniqueness, tombstone and optimistic-concurrency semantics from the accepted parity matrix.
Source tripwires reject PgPool, PostgresDatabase, SQLx and SQLite authority in Loom product or proof code.
proof_targets: Run Loom repository integration tests against a real disposable embedded SurrealDB namespace/database.
Run fresh-rollout, repeated-rollout, restart and atomic-failure tests.
Run source and Cargo-feature tripwires for forbidden database dependencies.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend storage foundation; consuming UI MTs own visual proof.

same_project_private_resource_cases: Membership alone does not grant access to a private Loom record.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged record and relation IDs fail closed.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Outbox and EventLedger payload visibility cannot exceed source visibility.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Stale repository context fails after revocation or AccessSpace switch.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Remote identifiers are data selectors, never local grants.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Denied records do not leak via existence, conflicts, rollout diagnostics or counts.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: typed mutation, denial, rollout and recovery events
schema version, rollout and repository health without content leakage
crash-safe operation identity and recovery handles

risk_if_missed: Loom can remain a PostgreSQL-shaped adapter over SurrealDB and preserve the migration defects WP-017 is meant to repair.

risks: Relations are stored as opaque foreign-key fields.
Rollout retry corrupts schema or data.
minimum_controls: Fresh and repeated real-Surreal rollout proof.

sources: Official SurrealDB DEFINE TABLE/FIELD and permissions documentation
research_provenance.selected_approach: SCHEMAFULL project-qualified records, native relations, typed repositories and atomic EventLedger/outbox writes.
rejected_options: PostgreSQL-shaped tables as the design target
Raw SDK calls across product modules
